content: Decimal.js v10.6.0 is an arbitrary-precision decimal library ideal for financial and crypto calculations. It handles both fractional crypto quantities (e.g. 0.00314159 BTC) and BRL monetary values without floating-point errors. Used by 3849+ npm packages including Prisma. More general-purpose than Dinero.js (which is money-only and less suited for crypto quantity math). Install: npm i decimal.js
